fields.statement: At 9abac36b, session.Stalled (internal/session/status.go) stalls a hook-sourced session only when working, or idle with Record.Autonomous true, and never when Status.SaidDone(), Status.Asked is set, usage-paused, blocked or exited. go test -trimpath ./internal/session -run TestStalled PASS: it covers autonomous idle at 19m (not stalled) and 21m (stalled), attended idle at 21m (not stalled), attended working at 21m (stalled), and at 21m idle/working with the done mark, idle/working with Asked, idle usage-paused, autonomous blocked and autonomous exited (none stalled). go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(inbox-stalled|describe-golden)$' PASS: inbox-stalled.txtar asserts that an idle record with no autonomous key gives no stalled item in inbox or run status at T+21m; after marking it autonomous, none at T+19m, a stalled inbox item at T+21m, and run status shows stalled; then with the done mark, none. go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run TestRunStalledNow PASS. make self-check fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered files for run actors, which are rendered after landing.
